# Neuctra

Neuctra builds software products and delivers custom technology solutions for businesses, founders, developers, and everyday users.

## Company overview
Neuctra combines product innovation with practical engineering and digital problem-solving. It builds its own software ecosystem and also helps clients create custom SaaS products, web applications, internal systems, and business software.

## Core products
- Authix: authentication, identity infrastructure, and app data foundations.
- UI: reusable React components and product design systems.
- Notlix: personal productivity and digital-life management.
- Tools: lightweight online utilities for everyday digital work.

## Services
Neuctra provides custom software development, SaaS platform design, web application development, internal dashboards, business automation, API work, and tailored technology solutions.

## Neuctra Lab
Neuctra Lab is the educational platform within Neuctra. It teaches technology, practical software development, and business problem-solving through tutorials, explanations, and real-world examples.
